correctness.rationale: The lower bound follows from the monotone singular-support union law under unit-top multiplication, while projection forces the independent top relative-rank contribution; an explicit construction gives the matching upper bound. The iterated formula follows from the product formula for unit-group orbit counts. The smallest displayed counterexample was exhaustively verified.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Targeted searches and inspection of the new source paper and closest indexed partition-rank literature did not locate the unit-orbit formula or the same correction. Older semigroup-generation literature remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The result replaces a false general transitivity lemma by a sharp equality, extends the iterated calculation to arbitrary finite transformation monoids, and explains exactly why the source paper's advertised main theorem survives.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
